financing.summary: Long Lake is a privately held, single-market Houston builder whose financing is not public: no SEC filings, rated debt, or announced credit facilities. It controls land through an affiliated developer, Woodmere Development Co., Ltd., under the same general-partner manager (Roger B. Medors), which bought a 494-acre tract near Bridgeland in Katy (2022) and 95 acres near Tomball in Montgomery County (closed October 2024, undisclosed price). It also builds in third-party master plans (Beacon Hill, Sunterra Lakes). No land banker, lot-option partner or capital partner is publicly named. Falling closings (943 in 2023 to 782 in 2025) and large owned raw-land tracts make it a plausible prospect for land-banking or lot-option capital, but there is no public sign it uses any.
financing.land_strategy: Mixed, leaning owned: the company says it knows 'where to acquire the best land' and develops in-house through Woodmere Development (own planned communities such as Morton Creek Ranch and a 270-acre project inside Beacon Hill), plus lots bought in others' master plans. No stated owned/optioned target.

lots.note: No lot counts published. The site lists 21 active communities and (home-builders page) 406 homes in inventory on 2026-11-19.

land_banking.source_title: Historic local family sells 95 acres for residential development in Montgomery County (HBJ story reposted by Wolff Companies, 2024-11)
land_banking.note: Affiliation confirmed by Texas Comptroller records: Woodmere GP, LLC and L.L. Manager, L.L.C. are both managed by Roger B. Medors (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/account-status/search/32008970991). Checker 2026-11-19: The Real Deal returns 403, so the source is now the Wolff repost, which calls Woodmere Long Lake's development arm and gives the 95-acre Decker Prairie-Rosehill Rd purchase (closed end of October 2024). The 494-acre Katy tract (2022) comes from The Real Deal (https://therealdeal.com/texas/houston/2024/11/25/long-lake-purchased-100-acre-tract-in-houston-area) and was not re-opened.
land_banking.description: Sister partnership (same GP manager, same office) that acquires and develops land for Long Lake: 494 acres at West and Katy Hockley roads, Katy (2022) and 95 acres at 26119 Decker Prairie-Rosehill Rd, Montgomery County (2024). In-house land development, not a land bank.
